pla-01.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Asset: AAC vocabulary image. Style: flat 2D educational illustration, simple solid colors, dark clear outlines, no 3D or photographic textures. Full-body adult man at center, plain orange shirt and blue trousers. Four distinct thought bubbles containing glass of water, plate of food, bed and toilet, linked to him by small thought dots. Shows personal basic NEEDS. All components fully inside frame with ample margins. Pure white background. One clear central concept, minimal necessary context, generous white margins on ALL sides. All people full body and all objects fully inside image, natural anatomy/hands. Anatomical detail may use natural body-part crop. Absolutely NO text, letters, numbers, punctuation, lettering, labels, branding, watermarks or pseudowriting anywhere, including tiny hardware and clothing. No border. Image square. Vocabulary word is displayed outside image by the app, never inside.
